notes: Refined existing stories to better align with schema/contract, core logic, UI integration, interaction, and testing coverage without creating new IDs.

change_log.value: Define frontend map data contract aligned with provider_search_service outputs including latitude, longitude, provider name, specialty, NPI identifier, and optional metadata (distance, address). Ensure strict typing and null handling for missing coordinates.
change_log.note: Strengthened schema contract and tied to backend output

change_log.value: Implement core map initialization logic including dynamic centering based on result bounds, marker clustering support for dense areas, and efficient re-rendering when provider datasets change.
change_log.note: Expanded core logic to include performance considerations

change_log.value: Integrate map component into Find Care UI, ensuring two-way synchronization: search results update map markers and map viewport changes (pan/zoom) can optionally influence visible provider list.
change_log.note: Clarified integration behavior and bidirectional sync

change_log.value: Enable interactive marker behavior including click-to-view provider summary, hover states, and synchronized highlighting between map markers and provider list items.
change_log.note: Expanded interaction detail for UX completeness

change_log.value: Create unit and integration tests covering schema validation, map initialization, marker rendering, clustering behavior, and synchronization between provider results and map state.
change_log.note: Expanded test coverage to include clustering and sync validation
